thm affine_parallelogram_witness:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
        c(1) = ((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1))
        c(2) = ((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2))
        =>:
            $f4::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    by contra:
        ? d != c
        d = c
        c(1) = d(1)
        c(2) = d(2)
        b(1) = ((((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - d(1)) + a(1)) = ((c(1) - d(1)) + a(1)) = ((d(1) - d(1)) + a(1)) = a(1)
        b(2) = ((((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - d(2)) + a(2)) = ((c(2) - d(2)) + a(2)) = ((d(2) - d(2)) + a(2)) = a(2)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = (((a(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((a(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = 0
        impossible m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    by contra:
        ? b != c
        b = c
        c(1) = b(1)
        c(2) = b(2)
        d(1) = ((((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) + a(1)) = ((c(1) - b(1)) + a(1)) = ((b(1) - b(1)) + a(1)) = a(1)
        d(2) = ((((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) + a(2)) = ((c(2) - b(2)) + a(2)) = ((b(2) - b(2)) + a(2)) = a(2)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (a(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (a(1) - a(1)))) = 0
        impossible m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    (c(1) - d(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - d(1)) = (b(1) - a(1))
    (c(1) - b(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) = (d(1) - a(1))
    (c(2) - d(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - d(2)) = (b(2) - a(2))
    (c(2) - b(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) = (d(2) - a(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    m0::f0::vec(a, b)(1) = (b(1) - a(1))
    m0::f0::vec(a, b)(2) = (b(2) - a(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(a, d)
    m0::f0::vec(a, d)(1) = (d(1) - a(1))
    m0::f0::vec(a, d)(2) = (d(2) - a(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(d, c)
    m0::f0::vec(d, c)(1) = (c(1) - d(1))
    m0::f0::vec(d, c)(2) = (c(2) - d(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(b, c)
    m0::f0::vec(b, c)(1) = (c(1) - b(1))
    m0::f0::vec(b, c)(2) = (c(2) - b(2))
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(d, c))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(d, c)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (c(2) - d(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (c(1) - d(1)))) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (b(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (b(1) - a(1)))) = 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(a, b, d, c)
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(b, c))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(b, c)) = (((d(1) - a(1)) * (c(2) - b(2))) - ((d(2) - a(2)) * (c(1) - b(1)))) = (((d(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((d(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(a, d, b, c)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, d, b)
    release thm m0::f0::det_antisymmetric(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b))
    by contra:
        ? m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b)) != 0
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b)) = 0
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (-(-m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)))) = (-m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b))) = (-0) = 0
        impossible m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    by def $f3::are_parallel_lines(a, b, d, c)
    by def $f3::are_parallel_lines(a, d, b, c)
    by def $f4::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
stores:
forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
    $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
    c(1) = ((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1))
    c(2) = ((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2))
    =>:

thm affine_parallelogram_area:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
        c(1) = ((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1))
        c(2) = ((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2))
        =>:
            exist common R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, common), $f4::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, (2 * common))}
    release thm affine_parallelogram_witness(a, b, c, d)
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(b, c, d)
    (c(1) - b(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) = (d(1) - a(1))
    (c(2) - b(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) = (d(2) - a(2))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) = (((c(1) - b(1)) * (d(2) - b(2))) - ((c(2) - b(2)) * (d(1) - b(1)))) = (((d(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - b(2))) - ((d(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - b(1)))) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(b, c, d)
    have common R+ = f4::triangle_area(a, b, d)
    $f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, common)
    by def $f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, common)
    (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2) = (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) ^ 2)
    (2 * common) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) ^ 2)) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2))
    by def $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, common)
    witness exist first, second R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, first), $f4::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, second), (2 * common) = (first + second)} from common, common
    by def $f4::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, (2 * common))
    witness exist half R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, half), $f4::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, (2 * half))} from common

thm proposition_42:
    ? forall a, b, c, p, q, r cart(R, R):
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, c)
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(q, p, r)
        =>:
            exist third, fourth cart(R, R), common R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, c, common), $f4::has_parallelogram_area(q, p, third, fourth, common), $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(p, q, fourth, p, q, r)}
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(q, p, r)
    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(q, p, r)
    have common R+ = f4::triangle_area(a, b, c)
    $f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, c, common)
    have determinant R = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(q, p), m0::f0::vec(q, r))
    determinant != 0
    (determinant ^ 2) > 0
    sqrt ((determinant ^ 2)) > 0
    have root R+ = sqrt ((determinant ^ 2))
    root != 0
    have scale R+ = (common / root)
    scale != 0
    have fourth cart(R, R) = ((q(1) + (scale * (r(1) - q(1)))), (q(2) + (scale * (r(2) - q(2)))))
    fourth(1) = (q(1) + (scale * (r(1) - q(1))))
    fourth(2) = (q(2) + (scale * (r(2) - q(2))))
    (fourth(1) - q(1)) = ((q(1) + (scale * (r(1) - q(1)))) - q(1)) = (scale * (r(1) - q(1)))
    (fourth(2) - q(2)) = ((q(2) + (scale * (r(2) - q(2)))) - q(2)) = (scale * (r(2) - q(2)))
    have third cart(R, R) = (((p(1) + fourth(1)) - q(1)), ((p(2) + fourth(2)) - q(2)))
    third(1) = ((p(1) + fourth(1)) - q(1))
    third(2) = ((p(2) + fourth(2)) - q(2))
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(q, p, r)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(q, p, fourth)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(q, p), m0::f0::vec(q, fourth)) = (((p(1) - q(1)) * (fourth(2) - q(2))) - ((p(2) - q(2)) * (fourth(1) - q(1)))) = (((p(1) - q(1)) * (scale * (r(2) - q(2)))) - ((p(2) - q(2)) * (scale * (r(1) - q(1))))) = (scale * (((p(1) - q(1)) * (r(2) - q(2))) - ((p(2) - q(2)) * (r(1) - q(1))))) = (scale * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(q, p), m0::f0::vec(q, r))) = (scale * determinant)
    by contra:
        ? m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(q, p), m0::f0::vec(q, fourth)) != 0
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(q, p), m0::f0::vec(q, fourth)) = 0
        (scale * determinant) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(q, p), m0::f0::vec(q, fourth)) = 0
        determinant = ((scale * determinant) / scale) = (0 / scale) = 0
        impossible determinant != 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(q, p, fourth)
    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(q, p, fourth)
    release thm affine_parallelogram_area(q, p, third, fourth)
    obtain half from exist value R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(q, p, fourth, value), $f4::has_parallelogram_area(q, p, third, fourth, (2 * value))}
    by def $f4::has_triangle_area(q, p, fourth, half)
    (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(q, p), m0::f0::vec(q, fourth)) ^ 2) = ((scale * determinant) ^ 2) = ((scale ^ 2) * (determinant ^ 2))
    (scale ^ 2) >= 0
    (determinant ^ 2) >= 0
    sqrt (((scale ^ 2) * (determinant ^ 2))) = (sqrt ((scale ^ 2)) * sqrt ((determinant ^ 2)))
    sqrt ((scale ^ 2)) = abs (scale) = scale
    (2 * half) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(q, p), m0::f0::vec(q, fourth)) ^ 2)) = sqrt (((scale ^ 2) * (determinant ^ 2))) = (sqrt ((scale ^ 2)) * sqrt ((determinant ^ 2))) = (scale * root) = ((common / root) * root) = common
    $f4::has_parallelogram_area(q, p, third, fourth, common)
    release thm f1::positive_ray_scale_preserves_cosine(p, q, r, fourth, scale)
    release thm f1::equal_cosines_imply_angle_relation(p, q, fourth, p, q, r)
    witness exist third_point, fourth_point cart(R, R), value R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, c, value), $f4::has_parallelogram_area(q, p, third_point, fourth_point, value), $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(p, q, fourth_point, p, q, r)} from third, fourth, common
stores:
forall a, b, c, p, q, r cart(R, R):
    $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, c)
    $m0::f0::is_triangle(q, p, r)
    =>:
        exist third, fourth cart(R, R), common R+ st {$f4::has_triangle_area(a, b, c, common), $f4::has_parallelogram_area(q, p, third, fourth, common), $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(p, q, fourth, p, q, r)}

thm proposition_23:
    ? forall a, b, d, c, e1 cart(R, R):
        a != b
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(c, d, e1)
        =>:
            exist g cart(R, R) st {$m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, g), $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(b, a, g, d, c, e1)}
    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(c, d, e1)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(c, d)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(c, e1)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(a, b)
    have k R+ = m0::f0::distance_sq(c, d)
    have v R+ = m0::f0::distance_sq(c, e1)
    have h R+ = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)
    have ux R = (d(1) - c(1))
    have uy R = (d(2) - c(2))
    have vx R = (e1(1) - c(1))
    have vy R = (e1(2) - c(2))
    have wx R = (b(1) - a(1))
    have wy R = (b(2) - a(2))
    have n R = ((ux * vx) + (uy * vy))
    have z R = ((ux * vy) - (uy * vx))
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(c, d)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(c, e1)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    k = ((ux ^ 2) + (uy ^ 2))
    v = ((vx ^ 2) + (vy ^ 2))
    h = ((wx ^ 2) + (wy ^ 2))
    ((n ^ 2) + (z ^ 2)) = ((((ux * vx) + (uy * vy)) ^ 2) + (((ux * vy) - (uy * vx)) ^ 2)) = (((ux ^ 2) + (uy ^ 2)) * ((vx ^ 2) + (vy ^ 2))) = (k * v)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(c, d, e1)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(c, d), m0::f0::vec(c, e1)) = ((ux * vy) - (uy * vx)) = z
    z != 0
    have gx R = (((n * wx) - (z * wy)) / k)
    have gy R = (((n * wy) + (z * wx)) / k)
    have g cart(R, R) = ((a(1) + gx), (a(2) + gy))
    (g(1) - a(1)) = gx
    (g(2) - a(2)) = gy
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, g)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, g)) = ((wx * gy) - (wy * gx)) = ((wx * (((n * wy) + (z * wx)) / k)) - (wy * (((n * wx) - (z * wy)) / k))) = ((z * ((wx ^ 2) + (wy ^ 2))) / k) = ((z * h) / k)
    by contra:
        ? ((z * h) / k) != 0
        ((z * h) / k) = 0
        z = (((z * h) / k) * (k / h)) = (0 * (k / h)) = 0
        impossible z != 0
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, g)) != 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, g)
    release thm f2::triangle_vertices_distinct(a, b, g)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, g)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(a, g) = ((gx ^ 2) + (gy ^ 2)) = (((((n * wx) - (z * wy)) / k) ^ 2) + ((((n * wy) + (z * wx)) / k) ^ 2)) = ((((n ^ 2) + (z ^ 2)) * ((wx ^ 2) + (wy ^ 2))) / (k ^ 2)) = (((k * v) * h) / (k ^ 2)) = ((v * h) / k)
    release thm m0::f0::perpendicular_dot_expand(a, b, a, g)
    m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, g)) = ((wx * gx) + (wy * gy)) = ((wx * (((n * wx) - (z * wy)) / k)) + (wy * (((n * wy) + (z * wx)) / k))) = ((n * ((wx ^ 2) + (wy ^ 2))) / k) = ((n * h) / k)
    release thm m0::f0::perpendicular_dot_expand(c, d, c, e1)
    m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(c, d), m0::f0::vec(c, e1)) = ((ux * vx) + (uy * vy)) = n
    m0::f0::angle_cos_num(b, a, g) = ((n * h) / k)
    m0::f0::angle_cos_num(d, c, e1) = n
    (v * h) > 0
    (h / k) > 0
    ((v * h) * (h / k)) > 0
    ((v * (h ^ 2)) / k) = ((v * h) * (h / k)) > 0
    m0::f0::angle_cos_den(b, a, g) = (m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b) * m0::f0::distance_sq(a, g)) = (h * ((v * h) / k)) = ((v * (h ^ 2)) / k)
    m0::f0::angle_cos_den(b, a, g) > 0
    m0::f0::angle_cos_den(d, c, e1) = (k * v) > 0
    ((m0::f0::angle_cos_num(b, a, g) ^ 2) * m0::f0::angle_cos_den(d, c, e1)) = ((((n * h) / k) ^ 2) * (k * v)) = ((n ^ 2) * ((v * (h ^ 2)) / k)) = ((m0::f0::angle_cos_num(d, c, e1) ^ 2) * m0::f0::angle_cos_den(b, a, g))
    (m0::f0::angle_cos_num(b, a, g) * m0::f0::angle_cos_num(d, c, e1)) = (((n * h) / k) * n) = ((n ^ 2) * (h / k)) >= 0
    by def $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(b, a, g, d, c, e1)
    witness exist gg cart(R, R) st {$m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, gg), $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(b, a, gg, d, c, e1)} from g
stores:
forall a, b, d, c, e1 cart(R, R):
    a != b
    $m0::f0::is_triangle(c, d, e1)
